record_identity.title: Google AI Overview falsely implicated musician in sexual offences and concert was cancelled

incident_identity.historical_event_name: Google AI Overview falsely implicated musician in sexual offences and concert was cancelled
incident_identity.date_basis: AIID records 19 December 2025 as the incident date.

summary: A Google AI-generated search summary reportedly confused Canadian musician Ashley MacIsaac with another person and falsely stated he had sexual-offence convictions; a venue reportedly relied on the output and cancelled a scheduled concert.

vigil_assessment.factual_basis: A Google AI-generated search summary reportedly confused Canadian musician Ashley MacIsaac with another person and falsely stated he had sexual-offence convictions; a venue reportedly relied on the output and cancelled a scheduled concert.
vigil_assessment.governance_interpretation: The occurrence is admitted as a bounded recent AI-related incident. Mechanism-level VIGIL taxonomy classification is intentionally withheld in this intake pass pending separate class adjudication.
vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: The occurrence broadens the Observatory's recent 2025–2026 coverage and provides evidence for later governance, harm and failure-mechanism comparison.
assessment_boundaries: The record is bounded to the reviewed public evidence and does not infer unreported model versions, mechanisms, intent, liability or downstream consequences.
Incident admission does not establish a VIGIL Failure Class.
